date_only_external_availability_rule: Guardian article volume, TTF, GPR and Brent are shifted two calendar days before differences, correlations, ECM construction and Granger-lag construction.
effective_external_timing: For target day t, a reported Granger lag L uses raw external information from t-(L+2).
calendar_lag_rule: All Granger designs are built on a complete daily calendar. A row is retained only if its differenced target and every required calendar-day target/cause/control lag are observed; missing Guardian days are not compressed, zero-filled or interpolated.
target_history_rule: The realised electricity price is retained as the target; only historical target lags enter the restricted/unrestricted models.
interpretation_scope: These are retrospective robustness diagnostics with conservative external-data availability, not operational same-day forecasts.
